title: HSK1 Gate 22 · Republic of China
explanationEn: Gate 22: Republic of China. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第22关：民国。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 一百多年以前，中国还有王。很多人想，中国要不一样。有一个人叫孙中山。他去过很多国家，看过很多事。
passageEn: A little over a hundred years ago China still had an emperor. Many people thought China should be different. There was a man called Sun Yat-sen. He had been to many countries and seen many things.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: A little over a hundred years ago China still had an emperor.
comprehension.answer: 一百多年以前，中国还有王。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: There was a man called Sun Yat-sen.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 一 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“一”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 一 (yī) means "one" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “一”（yī）的意思是“one”，就在上面的短文里。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 百 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“百”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 百 (bǎi) means "hundred" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “百”（bǎi）的意思是“hundred”，就在上面的短文里。

check.zh: 一百多年以前，中国还有王。

options.text: A little over a hundred years ago China still had an emperor.
Long ago, great floods came to China.
The floods came, and many people had no home.

check.explanationEn: "一百多年以前，中国还有王。" means "A little over a hundred years ago China still had an emperor.".
check.explanation: “一百多年以前，中国还有王。”的意思是“A little over a hundred years ago China still had an emperor.”。

speakingPromptEn: Tell a grown-up about Republic of China in two or three short Chinese sentences. Use words from the list above.
speakingPrompt: 用上面的词，跟家里的大人说两三句中文，说一说民国。
